scope: Separate conditional native CMB+DESI BAO+Pantheon+SH0ES target obtained by replacing the whole Dovekie SN factor, not by multiplying an H0 constraint into overlapping data.
parent_backend: CPU modern_fast; gpu must be false and fast_lensing true
weight_rule: target_logweight = original stored native/proposal logweight + new normalized anchored SN loglike - old stored exact native Dovekie SN loglike. All CMB/BAO components and all normalized priors cancel exactly and are retained in the target.
background: One CAMB get_background evaluation per selected point, with the identical native physical inputs and the already validated native_thermal_parameters flag adapter. Evaluate distances at the union of old/new noncalibrator redshifts and restore each full ordering. Prohibit native spectra/transfer-function calls. Reconstruct the old SN loglike at EVERY point before using the stored old density in the ratio.
calibration: Use the frozen ReleasedCalibration interface and complete1657-row selected covariance, with77calibrator and1580noncalibrator rows. Retain its explicit printed-covariance symmetrization and flat-M determinant/normalization. Do not add H0, Cepheid, geometric-anchor or overlapping SN factors. No evidence ratio is defined under the improper flat-M measure.
parent_qualification: The only public evaluation entry calls measurement_summary.summarize_run before any background, SN calculation or cache creation. No provisional-parent or gate-bypass mode exists. Reidentify all parent and target scientific inputs and assets.
child_qualification: Use every unchanged overlap_gates value in luminosity-sensitivity-design.json, including at least2000 exact points, rawESS400, each-chainESS50, Pareto k<0.7, four chains with weight fractions.05-.5, chain-mean discrepancy<=.3SD, batchMCSE<=.1SD and10points per batch. Retain all inherited prior coordinates in diagnostics. A failed density or weight gate yields no posterior/covariance/sign/paired-change measurement.
reporting: Retain native cosmological derived values; replace old sn_chi2 by the new anchored diagnostic in weight checks. Publish only physical parameters from measurement_summary.PARAMETERS, not nuisance-prior distributions. Paired shifts are not independent-fit significances. State units H0 km/s/Mpc, rdrag Mpc, w/wa/q/j dimensionless.
limits: Finite importance overlap cannot establish unseen-mode coverage. Poor H0 overlap requires dedicated anchored sampling, not clipped weights or relaxed gates. This target retains the released ladder/SN selection and calibration assumptions, physical CAMB domain and existing approximate cross-probe factorization; it does not infer cross-covariance or a progenitor-age correction.
validation: Normalized Gaussian-factor replacement against direct conjugate algebra, null substitution and additive-constant invariance, changed prior/non-SN configuration rejection, source-density failure, concentrated weights and too few points withholding results, fake-background consumer cache replay/tampering tests, and refusal of an unqualified parent before work. No observational bridge or CAMB evaluation is part of validation.
